final_message:
Done. The full suite passes (6/6) and `SOLUTION.md` documents the fixes:

1. **`get` didn't refresh recency** — a hit returned the value without moving the key to the MRU end, so recently-read keys were wrongly evicted. Fixed with `move_to_end(key)` on a valid hit.
2. **`put` evicted unconditionally at capacity** — updating an existing key in a full cache evicted another entry first, even though an update adds nothing. Fixed by only evicting when the key is new.
